panels.description: Network Weathermap NG view of Zabbix map Hijo network map (map_id 3). Device positions and connections are snapshotted from the normalized Zabbix map; node status and problem counts refresh through /api/dashboard/zabbix. Green nodes are available with no active problems, orange nodes are available with active problems, red nodes are unavailable, yellow is maintenance, and gray is disabled/unknown. Links are endpoint-derived only: green means neither endpoint is unavailable; red blinking means at least one endpoint is unavailable. This does not prove physical/interface/circuit health. Traffic-flow animation is intentionally disabled because the normalized topology contract does not expose traffic telemetry.
